newsitem.title: USA: North Carolina governor gets veto power.
newsitem.headline: North Carolina governor gets veto power.

text.p: North Carolina residents voted overwhelmingly to give their governor the power to veto bills, state elections officials said Friday.
The constitutional amendment passed by a margin of about 3-1 in Tuesday's election.
North Carolina had been the only state whose governor did not have veto powers. The state General Assembly agreed during its last sesson to put the proposal on the November ballot.
Legislators could still override the governor's veto by a three-fifths majority vote in both houses.
